info.title: EVPN_Instance
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

ethernet_tag.description: The Ethernet TAG ID of the EVPN instance. This filed is applicable to EVIs that are part of VLAN Aware Bundle service.

evi.description:
Reference Resource: [EVPN_Instance](#/EVPN_Instance)
Index identifying the EVPN instance.

export_route_targets.description: Export Route Targets for this EVPN instance.

import_route_targets.description: Import Route Targets for this EVPN instance.

operational_failure_reason.description: Operational failure reason of the EVPN instance: 'entity-not-up'           : EVPN entity is not up. 'admin-config'            : Admin status is disabled. 'resource-failure'        : Insufficient resources. 'no-if-info'              : Incomplete interface information. 'evi-not-up'              : EVPN instance is not up. 'bd-not-up'               : EVPN bridge domain is not up. 'no-route-distinguisher'  : No route distinguisher configured. 'route-dist-conflict'     : This EVPN instance's RD is the same as                             another active instance's RD. 'no-esi'                  : No Ethernet Segment Identifier is available. 'bad-vni'                 : Invalid VNI. 'vni-conflict'            : There is another bridge domain with the                             same VNI. 'vlan-sub-if-evi-conflict': Multiple VLAN sub-interfaces have been                             configured for the same EVI on the same                             Ethernet Segment. 'no-bgp-id'               : BGP router identifier is not yet available                             to EVPN. 'rt-type-conflict'        : Configured route target and the auto-derived                             route target have the same route target value                             but different route target types. 'no-rt'                   : No configured route targets. 'ip-vrf-not-up'           : IP VRF instance is not up. 'no-system-mac'           : System MAC address is not known. 'rt-conflict'             : There is an another active route target                             configured with the same route target value. 'eth-tag-conflict'        : There is another EVI with the same                             Ethernet tag.

operational_status.description: Operational status of the EVPN instance: 'up'         : Active. 'down'       : Inactive. 'going-up'   : Activating. 'going-down' : Deactivating. 'act-failed' : Activation failed.

rd.description: Route distinguisher for this EVPN instance.

remote_mac_count_per_vtep_peer.description: Count of MAC addresses learned from each VTEP peer on this EVPN instance.

local_mac_count.description: Count of locally learned MAC addresses on this EVPN instance.

peer_vtep_count.description: Number of VTEP peers learned on this EVPN instance.

remote_mac_count.description: Count of remote MAC addresses learned on this EVPN instance.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
